entries.title: Lamentations 3:1
segments: ¶I am the man who has seen trouble by the rod of his wrath.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:2
segments: By him I have been made to go in the dark where there is no light.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:3
segments: Truly against me his hand has been turned again and again all the day.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:4
segments: My flesh and my skin have been used up by him and my bones broken.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:5
segments: He has put up a wall against me, shutting me in with bitter sorrow.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:6
segments: He has kept me in dark places, like those who have been long dead.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:7
segments: He has put a wall round me, so that I am not able to go out; he has made great the weight of my chain.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:8
segments: Even when I send up a cry for help, he keeps my prayer shut out.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:9
segments: He has put up a wall of cut stones about my ways, he has made my roads twisted.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:10
segments: He is like a bear waiting for me, like a lion in secret places.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:11
segments: By him my ways have been turned on one side and I have been pulled in bits; he has made me waste.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:12
segments: With his bow bent, he has made me the mark for his arrows.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:13
segments: He has let loose his arrows into the inmost parts of my body.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:14
segments: I have become the sport of all the peoples; I am their song all the day.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:15
segments: He has made my life nothing but pain, he has given me the bitter root in full measure.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:16
segments: By him my teeth have been broken with crushed stones, and I am bent low in the dust.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:17
segments: My soul is sent far away from peace, I have no more memory of good.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:18
segments: And I said, My strength is cut off, and my hope from the Lord.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:19
segments: Keep in mind my trouble and my wandering, the bitter root and the poison.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:20
segments: My soul still keeps the memory of them; and is bent down in me.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:21
segments: ¶This I keep in mind, and because of this I have hope.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:22
segments: It is through the Lord's love that we have not come to destruction, because his mercies have no limit.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:23
segments: They are new every morning; great is your good faith.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:24
segments: I said to myself, The Lord is my heritage; and because of this I will have hope in him.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:25
segments: The Lord is good to those who are waiting for him, to the soul which is looking for him.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:26
segments: It is good to go on hoping and quietly waiting for the salvation of the Lord.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:27
segments: It is good for a man to undergo the yoke when he is young.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:28
segments: Let him be seated by himself, saying nothing, because he has put it on him.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:29
segments: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if by chance there may be hope.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:30
segments: Let his face be turned to him who gives him blows; let him be full of shame.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:31
segments: For the Lord does not give a man up for ever.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:32
segments: For though he sends grief, still he will have pity in the full measure of his love.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:33
segments: For he has no pleasure in troubling and causing grief to the children of men.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:34
segments: In a man's crushing under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

entries.title: Lamentations 3:35
segments: In his turning away the right of a man before the face of the Most High.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:36
segments: In his doing wrong to a man in his cause, the Lord has no pleasure.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:37
segments: ¶Who is able to say a thing, and give effect to it, if it has not been ordered by the Lord?

entries.title: Lamentations 3:38
segments: Do not evil and good come from the mouth of the Most High?

entries.title: Lamentations 3:39
segments: What protest may a living man make, even a man about the punishment of his sin?

entries.title: Lamentations 3:40
segments: Let us make search and put our ways to the test, turning again to the Lord;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:41
segments: Lifting up our hearts with our hands to God in the heavens.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:42
segments: ¶We have done wrong and gone against your law; we have not had your forgiveness.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:43
segments: Covering yourself with wrath you have gone after us, cutting us off without pity;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:44
segments: Covering yourself with a cloud, so that prayer may not get through.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:45
segments: You have made us like waste and that for which there is no use, among the peoples.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:46
segments: The mouths of all our haters are open wide against us.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:47
segments: Fear and deep waters have come on us, wasting and destruction.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:48
segments: Rivers of water are running down from my eyes, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:49
segments: My eyes are streaming without stopping, they have no rest,

entries.title: Lamentations 3:50
segments: Till the Lord's eye is turned on me, till he sees my trouble from heaven.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:51
segments: The Lord is unkind to my soul, more than all the daughters of my town.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:52
segments: They who are against me without cause have gone hard after me as if I was a bird;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:53
segments: They have put an end to my life in the prison, stoning me with stones.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:54
segments: Waters were flowing over my head; I said, I am cut off.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:55
segments: ¶I was making prayer to your name, O Lord, out of the lowest prison.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:56
segments: My voice came to you; let not your ear be shut to my breathing, to my cry.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:57
segments: You came near in the day when I made my prayer to you: you said, Have no fear.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:58
segments: O Lord, you have taken up the cause of my soul, you have made my life safe.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:59
segments: O Lord, you have seen my wrong; be judge in my cause.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:60
segments: You have seen all the evil rewards they have sent on me, and all their designs against me.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:61
segments: Their bitter words have come to your ears, O Lord, and all their designs against me;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:62
segments: The lips of those who came up against me, and their thoughts against me all the day.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:63
segments: Take note of them when they are seated, and when they get up; I am their song.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:64
segments: You will give them their reward, O Lord, answering to the work of their hands.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:65
segments: You will let their hearts be covered over with your curse on them.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:66
segments: You will go after them in wrath, and put an end to them from under the heavens of the Lord.
